data.title: 夜刀神十香 · 雨后水洼的小跳跃
data.description: 雨刚停，十香穿橙色雨衣和背带长裤，轻轻迈跳过小水洼，在两只雨靴落地后开心地抬起手。她回头看水面还在扩散的涟漪，长发跟着转身扬起，像发现新游戏般高兴。
data.action: 跳过水洼稳稳落地，回头开心看着涟漪。
data.promptProse: On a glistening residential lane just after a passing shower, Tohka wears her bright orange raincoat, navy overalls, and yellow rubber boots as she lands lightly on both feet just past a rainwater puddle. Raising one arm joyfully for balance, she twists back over her shoulder with a wide, beaming smile to watch the circular ripples spreading across the clear water. Soft post-rain afternoon daylight reflects off the wet asphalt and the bright yellow toes of her boots.
data.animaCaption: Landing with both yellow boots just beyond a rain puddle in her orange raincoat and navy overalls, Tohka lifts one arm joyfully and turns back to watch the spreading ripples. Clear after-rain afternoon daylight gleams across the wet residential lane.
